subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should a workflow/security owner approve these six upstream GitHub Action revisions before this credential-bearing automation update merges?
rationale: The patch changes third-party executable code in security scanning and container-publishing workflows; immutable pins limit substitution risk but do not determine whether each selected upstream revision is acceptable for the repository’s credentialed workflows.

options.title: Approve reviewed revisions
options.body: Confirm the six immutable action revisions are acceptable and merge after the current-head checks are green.

options.title: Hold for upstream review
options.body: Keep the PR open until a workflow owner validates the upstream changes or selects alternate pinned revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: Confirm the six immutable action revisions are acceptable and merge after the current-head checks are green.
